This chat is very cold and very tasty and something new. I will not tell the name of today's chat because I have to suggest you what to give the name of this recipe. So you have to tell me in the comment section that what you have named this recipe. Give us a first comment on this recipe and think of naming after this recipe. You may eat Sev puris but we are going to present, 1 cup black pepper powder, to use ghee. this happens for dough. any ingredients for chaat I have taken all the ingredients in this video. in my next video I will tell you all that ingredients are used. Now let us prepare the dough. First I am showing you all the important thing to prepare make the dough, what all ingredients we need to prepare the dough? Normally when we make chaat ki puri we add ghee or oil. But today we are going to heat the ghee. Firstly turn on the gas. Take 2 tbsp Ghee, heat heat up. take a cup of Maida Or else you can also do 2.5 cups with this add black pepper powder keep the level only less than 1teaspoon add 1 tea spoon salt now heat oil add oil heat ghee add flour Ghee is heated. Now add to paratha Mix well make sure hand isn't burnt ghee should remain hot mix well add more water this will make puri crispy when it will burst then puri will be rare you can make puri also now we make puri in different way we are making one puri of this chhat but only that it will come in a 4th category but we are doing something new you can see this part 2 should be ready This much you gotta give mould I have taken ghee. You can use oil instead of ghee Take dough I have taken cold water and keep the dough little hard don't make it soft Add little water Add a drop of water mix well Dough is ready. Leave it for 10-15 minutes Cover and leave it for 10 minutes Here I have wet the cloth so that the flour does not dry set it aside now I will tell you all the ingredients required for a chaat here I have taken sweet chutney along with it i have taken sweet chutney. Green chutney, which is made with fresh coriander leaves, mint leaves, green chilli. Pomegranate, boondi. It is available in dry boondi market. I bought mashala boondi. You can buy plain boondi if you want. And chana boondi. Add coriander, garlic, salt, cumin, red chilli powder, black salt, red chilli powder, cumin, coriander, red chilli powder, onion, chopped coriander, red chilli powder and ginger. Put all 3 ingredients. Now make 1 sweet curd. Now we are going to prepare one sweets curd, this one is prepared in chaat in small quantity, if you are taking even just 1 kg. and we will be using 100 gm of sugar powder in front. I have taken one curd... 1.5 cup curd The curd should be thick... And cold And here am adding 2 table spoon sugar And i have crushed in my mixer Add in in the mixer make a thick curd to be filled easily now sieve it how to make thick curd i have uploaded its video you can also follow this recipe this make curd really nice if you avoid it Very delicious, creamy and thick. You can also watch this video which i have shown on my channel Now curd will be ready Add Sweet curd Mix well you can keep the curd thick or not thick and this will taste good keep it to cool off set the dough set Make small balls out of it Knead well Knead well to make the poori ready We are going to make a new recipe of poori Small rounds Now today, I have shared with you the recipe from yesterday which was prepared by many students. And they had sent me pictures in the evening also. And many of the people had sent me pic a few minutes morning by pizza. And many students had sent me pictures from Dal Khichdi. And thank you so much to all of you for the quick recipe. Also yesterday many students commented and liked my video thank you so much for inspiring me now let's make small balls and the remaining dough cover and keep it like this so that it does not dry Cover the remaining flour and press it with your hand. do press with hand press well this is very tasty all will taste new it taste different than chat It has so many available variety and flavor. We have eaten sev,puri,pani puri and bhela. Only two thing to look out for in Chaat.
